mobility shifts in IMS depended on interaction energy between the analyte and the shift reagent, charge delocalisation, and steric hinderance.

the mobility shift of caffeine and glucosamine by adducting with 2-butol depends on interaction energy, delocalization of positive charge, and steric hinderance.
